paragraphs.text: Noggle is creature type for a small humanoid creature with an oversized head like a donkey 's. Noggles are typically the size of a dwarf or kithkin , and exhibit a hunched posture. Noggles have large, floppy ears; hooved feet; and a coat of short, coarse hair. Despite physical similarities with Unhinged 's donkeyfolk , the two species hold no relationship.
Noggles are aligned with red and either blue or green mana.

The design of Noggles is based on nuggles , mythical water horses of primarily Shetland folklore. These are similar in nature to the Irish púca , which appeared in the same sets as horse-headed shapeshifters .
The creature type was first introduced in Eventide , which printed four noggle creatures.

Noggles returned in Lorwyn Eclipsed with the card Noggle Robber . Lorwyn Eclipsed ' s Alchemy set, Alchemy: Lorwyn , introduced the first legendary noggle, Pep, Raucous Raider . Unlike the original noggles, Noggle Robber and Pep are both red-green aligned.
Noggles are thought to be exclusive to the plane of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor , and are unlikely to appear elsewhere in the multiverse.

Noggles are unique to Shadowmoor. After the defeat of Oona and the end of the plane's cycle of day and night, noggles were considered to inhabit "the far reaches of Shadowmoor". However, with the balance between the planes' aspects disturbed and boundries shifting, noggles and other Shadowmoor exclusive denizens have started to appear in Lorwyn, the plane's daytime aspect.

The noggles believe themselves to be the oldest race native to Shadowmoor and that the other tribes stole the plane from them. This has made many noggles bitter and given them a kleptomaniac streak, as they believe that everything in the world belongs to them and that they have the right to steal anything they find by any means. Noggles as a people have no crafts or industries, stealing everything they need from others. Many noggles also have a cruel sense of humor and enjoy playing harmful tricks on others.
Pulped noggle hoof is an ingredient in some kithkin alchemical mixtures.
